title: Fixed intrinsic finite-operation realizations
statement: For a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ and positive integer $n$, put $A=\mathcal O_E/\varpi_E^n$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. For a scheme $T$ use the canonical exact equivalence $e_T$ from fixed-module derived objects to intrinsic constant-ring derived objects [def-weil-pbc-proetale-modules]. Write $I_T$ for the full finite-Tor constructible inclusion [def-weil-finite-tor-amplitude]. Define $R_T=I_T e_T^{-1}$. For a specified compactification $c$ [def-weil-compactifications-refinements], define the intrinsic right functor $H_c$ by $e_Y^{-1}R\nu_{Y,*}f^\times_{c,A}\nu_X^*e_X$ in diagrammatic composition order [def-weil-exceptional-inverse-image]. Retain the canonical integer-shift structures from the derived coefficient equivalence, comparison functors and the etale adjunction. If $F,G$ are literal restrictions of intrinsic support and $H_c$, respectively, their realization isomorphisms are the inclusion equalities followed only by associators and cancellation of the coefficient-equivalence unit/counit and the canonical proper/open support comparison. The realized Hom chain is the specified etale-origin Hom equivalence of [def-sf-specified-exceptional-hom-chain].
